_comment: Standards row: names and one-line roles only; no third-party logos we do not have rights to use. The first five are implemented in the code, checked 2026-09-25 and corrected 2026-09-26: a passport is signed as a JSON Web Signature (RFC 7515) under a did:web identity; W3C Verifiable Credentials are the access credentials readers present and the revocation lists behind them, NOT the passport's own format (the row said so until 2026-09-26; the SD-JWT VC form of a passport is in the open library but the node does not issue it yet). The fifth is the set of six harmonised DPP standards cited by Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1736 (OJ 15.7.2026: EN 18216, 18219, 18220, 18221, 18222, 18223; not a range, there is no 18217 or 18218). Alignment with them is work in progress, and the row says so.
